question: Qual é o intervalo de relubrificação de um motor Baldor com rolamentos de esferas, carcaça NEMA 256, operando a 1800 RPM?

expected_answer: 9,500 hours (frame over 210 up to 280 incl., 1800 RPM).

expected_answer: 9,500 hours (frame over 210 up to 280 incl., 1800 RPM).

question: Com que frequência devo relubrificar um motor Baldor?
expected_answer: Depends on frame size and rated speed (e.g. 5,500 h for frame up to 210 at 3600 RPM up to 22,000 h at 900 RPM). Should ask for / enumerate frame size and RPM.

question: ¿Cada cuánto debo volver a engrasar un motor Baldor?
expected_answer: Depends on frame size and rated speed (e.g. 5,500 h for frame up to 210 at 3600 RPM up to 22,000 h at 900 RPM). Should ask for / enumerate frame size and RPM.

question: Wie oft sollte ich einen Baldor-Motor nachschmieren?
expected_answer: Depends on frame size and rated speed (e.g. 5,500 h for frame up to 210 at 3600 RPM up to 22,000 h at 900 RPM). Should ask for / enumerate frame size and RPM.

question: Qual é a profundidade máxima de submersão do motor de bomba submersível CA da Baldor com selos em tandem?
expected_answer: 160 ft (49 m) depth and/or 100 PSI (690 kPa) at the external motor seal.

question: ¿Cuál es la profundidad máxima de inmersión del motor de bomba sumergible de CA Baldor con sellos en tándem?
expected_answer: 160 ft (49 m) depth and/or 100 PSI (690 kPa) at the external motor seal.

question: Wie groß ist die maximale Eintauchtiefe des Baldor-Tauchpumpenmotors (Wechselstrom) mit Tandemdichtungen?
expected_answer: 160 ft (49 m) depth and/or 100 PSI (690 kPa) at the external motor seal.

question: Qual é o prazo de garantia dos redutores WEG-CESTARI?
expected_answer: Produtos: 12 meses a partir da emissão da Nota Fiscal; serviços: 6 meses.

question: ¿Cuál es el plazo de garantía de los reductores WEG-CESTARI?
expected_answer: Produtos: 12 meses a partir da emissão da Nota Fiscal; serviços: 6 meses.

question: Wie lange ist die Garantiezeit für WEG-CESTARI-Getriebe?
expected_answer: Produtos: 12 meses a partir da emissão da Nota Fiscal; serviços: 6 meses.

question: Quais graus de proteção IP são os mais usados em motores elétricos WEG?
expected_answer: IP21, IP23, IP44 and IP55 (the first two are open motors, the last two totally enclosed).

question: ¿Qué grados de protección IP son los más utilizados en los motores eléctricos WEG?
expected_answer: IP21, IP23, IP44 and IP55 (the first two are open motors, the last two totally enclosed).

question: Welche IP-Schutzarten werden bei WEG-Elektromotoren am häufigsten verwendet?
expected_answer: IP21, IP23, IP44 and IP55 (the first two are open motors, the last two totally enclosed).

question: Para um redutor WEG-CESTARI com óleo sintético poliglicol (CLP PG) a uma temperatura de operação de 90 °C, qual é o intervalo de troca de óleo?
expected_answer: 13,000 hours.

question: Para un reductor WEG-CESTARI que usa aceite sintético de poliglicol (CLP PG) a una temperatura de operación de 90 °C, ¿cuál es el intervalo de cambio de aceite?
expected_answer: 13,000 hours.

question: Wie lang ist das Ölwechselintervall für ein WEG-CESTARI-Getriebe mit synthetischem Polyglykolöl (CLP PG) bei einer Betriebstemperatur von 90 °C?
expected_answer: 13,000 hours.

question: Quanta graxa devo colocar num motor Baldor de carcaça 324?
expected_answer: 0.81 oz (23.1 g) of grease (1.5 in³, 5.2 teaspoons): frame over 280 up to 360 incl. (IEC 225).

question: ¿Cada cuánto hay que cambiar las escobillas de puesta a tierra del eje en un motor Baldor de 1800 RPM?
expected_answer: 44,000 hours (shaft grounding brush replacement interval at 1800 RPM, all frame sizes).

question: Darf ein Baldor-Motor im Stillstand nachgeschmiert werden, und bis zu welcher Temperatur?
expected_answer: Yes: Baldor motors can be regreased while stopped (at less than 80 °C) or running.

question: Em que tipo de ambiente podem ser usados os motores abertos à prova de pingos (ODP)?
expected_answer: In clean, dry locations with an adequate supply of cooling air; not in the presence of flammable or combustible materials.

question: What must be done with the capacitors of a single phase motor before servicing it?
expected_answer: Discharge the start and/or run capacitors before servicing.

question: Qual a pressão máxima na vedação externa do motor submersível com vedação para lama (slurry seal)?
expected_answer: 15 PSI (103 kPa) maximum external motor seal pressure for slurry seal designs.

question: ¿Cuánto tiempo como máximo puede funcionar el motor sumergible a plena carga sin estar cubierto por el líquido?
expected_answer: No more than 15 minutes (the time to draw the well down from the top of the motor to the bottom of the pump).

question: Welches Feuchtigkeitsüberwachungsgerät wird für die Feuchtigkeitssonden des Tauchpumpenmotors benötigt?
expected_answer: A leakage detector control such as the Ametek APT Series 8040MD Moisture Detector (or equivalent), purchased separately.

question: Qual é o ângulo máximo do cabo de içamento do motor submersível quando não se usa barra espaçadora?
expected_answer: 45° from vertical at most (angle of the lift rope without a spreader bar).

question: What happens to the warranty if the leakage detector of the submersible motor is not connected?
expected_answer: The motor warranty is void (and the U/L listing is not valid) if the leakage detector system is not properly connected and used.

question: ¿Qué variación de frecuencia y de tensión respecto a la placa admite el motor de bomba sumergible?
expected_answer: Frequency within ±5% and voltage within ±10% above or below the nameplate rating.

question: Up to what altitude and ambient temperature do WEG motors deliver their rated power without derating?
expected_answer: Up to 1,000 m altitude and 40 °C ambient (cooling medium) temperature.

question: ¿Qué potencia tiene la resistencia de calefacción de un motor WEG con carcasa 225?
expected_answer: Two heaters of 28 W (frame 225 to 250).

question: Above what relative humidity does a WEG motor need tropicalized painting?
expected_answer: Above 95% relative humidity (epoxy 'tropicalized' painting on the internal parts).

question: Welche maximale Oberflächentemperatur gilt für die Temperaturklasse T4?
expected_answer: 135 °C (temperature class T4).

question: ¿Qué significa un factor de servicio igual a 1,0 en un motor WEG?
expected_answer: FS = 1.0 means the motor is not designed to run continuously above its rated power; its capacity for momentary overloads is unchanged.

question: How long can a WEG-CESTARI gear unit stay in storage if the relative humidity is below 50%?
expected_answer: Up to 3 years (otherwise the long-term storage guidelines cover up to 2 years).

question: Welcher kr-Faktor gilt für einen Flachriemen mit Spannrolle bei WEG-CESTARI-Getrieben?
expected_answer: kr = 2.5 (flat belt with tensioner).

question: What is the minimum ambient temperature to start a gear unit filled with ISO VG 320 mineral oil, with splash lubrication?
expected_answer: +7 °C (mineral CLP oil, ISO VG 320, immersion/splash lubrication).

question: ¿Con qué tolerancia deben mecanizarse los agujeros de acoplamientos y poleas que se montan en los ejes del reductor?
expected_answer: Tolerance H7.

question: Does the WEG-CESTARI warranty cover oil leaks through the seals caused by paint applied by the customer?
expected_answer: No: oil leaks through the lip seals caused by drying from coatings or paints applied by the end user or the machine supplier are excluded from the warranty.

question: Um wie viel Grad ist die Gehäuseaußentemperatur eines WEG-CESTARI-Getriebes niedriger als die Öltemperatur?
expected_answer: About 15 °C below the operating (oil) temperature.

question: Which WEG-CESTARI gear unit lines have no oil level indicator?
expected_answer: Alumag, Magma M and WCG20 have no oil level indication.

question: What is the HN10-WD plug on a WEG-CESTARI gear unit?
expected_answer: A hexagonal oil level plug (model HN10-WD, similar to DIN 510), different from the other plugs of the gear unit; the correct oil level is at the level of the plug, with the gear unit stopped in its working position.

question: O detector Ametek 8040MD é fornecido junto com o motor?
expected_answer: No: the Ametek APT 8040MD moisture detector (or equivalent) must be purchased separately.

question: ¿Qué intervalo de lubricación aplica a los rodamientos 6313 o 6314?
expected_answer: 2,200 hours at 3600 RPM: the starred interval for 6313 or 6314 bearings used in 360 through 5000 frame, 2-pole motors.

question: What is the maximum sound power level of a 4-pole IC411 motor with frame 225 at no load?
expected_answer: 87 dB(A) sound power (4 poles, frame 225, IC411, no load, 60 Hz).

question: Was bedeutet die Schutzart IP55 bei WEG-Motoren?
expected_answer: IP55: complete protection against touch, protection against accumulation of harmful dust, and protection against water jets from all directions (an enclosed motor).

question: ¿Qué tipos de protección Ex se permiten en la Zona 1 según ABNT NBR IEC 60079-14?
expected_answer: Zone 1: Ex db, Ex db eb, Ex eb, Ex pxb, Ex pyb, Ex ib, Ex q, Ex ob, Ex mb (and equipment certified for Zone 0).

question: Minimum starting temperature for ISO VG 460 synthetic oil with immersion lubrication?
expected_answer: +6 °C (synthetic CLP HC (PAO) oil, ISO VG 460, immersion lubrication).
